en yderside.explanation: "En yderside" means "an outside", the outer surface of something: Ydersiden af kassen er rød (The outside of the box is red). The opposite is en inderside (an inside).

sentence.en: We are painting the outside of the house today.

en yndlingsbog.explanation: "En yndlingsbog" means "a favorite book", the one you like best: Det er min yndlingsbog (It is my favorite book). Put yndlings- (favorite) in front of many words to say what you like best.

sentence.da: Jeg har læst min **yndlingsbog** mange gange.
sentence.en: I have read my favorite book many times.

en yndlingsfarve.explanation: "En yndlingsfarve" means "a favorite color". It is built from yndling (favorite) and farve (color): Min yndlingsfarve er rød (My favorite color is red). The same works for food: min yndlingsmad (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfarve** er grøn, og min søsters er blå.
sentence.en: My favorite color is green, and my sister's is blue.

en yndlingsfilm.explanation: "En yndlingsfilm" means "a favorite movie", the one you like best: Hvad er din yndlingsfilm? (What is your favorite movie?). Put yndlings- (favorite) in front of other words the same way.

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfilm** er meget gammel, men jeg elsker den.
sentence.en: My favorite movie is very old, but I love it.

en yndlingsret.explanation: "En yndlingsret" means "a favorite dish". It is built from yndling (favorite) and ret (dish): Min yndlingsret er lasagne (My favorite dish is lasagna).

sentence.en: My favorite dish is pancakes with jam.

en yndlingssang.explanation: "En yndlingssang" means "a favorite song", the one you like best: Det her er min yndlingssang (This is my favorite song). Yndlings- (favorite) works in front of many words.

sentence.en: I sing my favorite song in the car.

en yogamåtte.explanation: "En yogamåtte" means "a yoga mat", the soft mat you stand or sit on to do yoga: Rul yogamåtten ud (Roll out the yoga mat). It is built from yoga and måtte (mat).

sentence.da: Hun ruller sin **yogamåtte** ud og laver yoga.
sentence.en: She rolls out her yoga mat and does yoga.

ydre.explanation: "Ydre" means "outer" and points to the outside part of something: den ydre side (the outer side). It keeps the same form with every word.

sentence.en: The outer walls of the house are white.

yndlings-.explanation: "Yndlings-" means "favorite" and goes in front of another word to build one: yndlingsmad (favorite food). Write it together with the word: yndlingsbog (favorite book).

yngre.explanation: "Yngre" means "younger". It is the step up from ung (young): Hun er yngre end mig (She is younger than me).

sentence.en: My sister is younger than me.

yngst.explanation: "Yngst" means "youngest" and is the step up from yngre (younger): Hun er yngst (She is the youngest).

sentence.en: Anna is the youngest of my children.

yoga.explanation: "Yoga" means "yoga". To say you do it, use at lave (to do): Hun laver yoga om aftenen (She does yoga in the evening).

sentence.da: Jeg vil gerne lave **yoga** hver morgen.
sentence.en: I would like to do yoga every morning.

yoghurt.explanation: "En yoghurt" means "a yogurt", one pot of it. For yogurt as a food, say noget yoghurt (some yogurt).
